name: Soulbeet
description: Soulbeet is a self-hosted music downloader and library manager. It finds albums and tracks on Soulseek through slskd, tags and files them into your library with beets, and can push discovery playlists from your Last.fm or ListenBrainz history to Navidrome.

notes.text: Anyone who reaches port 9765 can sign up and take over the instance, including the stored slskd API key. Keep it on a trusted network and change the admin password in Settings > Users right away.
Needs a separate slskd 0.26+ instance. Enter its URL and API key in Settings > Config and mount its downloads folder here, e.g. pct set <CTID> -mp0 /path/to/downloads,mp=/opt/soulbeet_data/downloads.

Mount the music share Navidrome reads at /opt/soulbeet_data/music and add it in Settings > Library. For Navidrome logins and playlists, uncomment NAVIDROME_URL in /opt/soulbeet_data/.env and restart soulbeet.
